title: JSON mode hedging + schema telemetry playbook for constrained decoding
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a repeatable test/playbook that evaluates JSON mode enforcement under partial-stream emissions and constrained decoding across multiple model variants (FP16, 8-bit, quantized, and distilled). Focus areas: hedging strategies for partial/ambiguous emits, quantifying schema adherence regressions introduced by decoder heuristics, and surfacing actionable telemetry for Console dashboards and automated rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: A telemetry schema with at least 10 KPIs (violation_rate, partial_emit_rate, recovery_success, avg_retries, latency_p50/p95, per-model-variant_breakdown) is defined and ingested into the Console metrics pipeline.
Automated test suite covers streaming partial-emits: sentinel insertion, backoff+retry, and sentinel-removal heuristics across 6 model variants with reproducible fixtures.
Schema violation detection precision >= 95% and recall >= 90% on the seeded test corpus (10k prompts with synthetic edge cases).
A conservative hedging policy (default) that achieves >= 99% service continuity for canary traffic while reducing hard-fail JSON-mode incidents by >= 75% compared to baseline.
Playbook includes explicit rollback criteria and an A/B rollout plan instrumented with the new KPIs.
PRs for runtime instrumentation and the test harness are merged and linkable from the ticket.
test_plan: Construct a representative prompt corpus: 8k normal prompts, 1.5k edge/partial-stream prompts, 500 adversarial schema-violation prompts.
Create fixtures for streaming emission patterns: clean, truncated, interleaved-toolcall, token-noise, and early-termination.
Run each fixture against model variants: rdx-7b-fp16, rdx-13b-8bit, rdx-13b-quantized, rdx-3b-distilled, and two community models.

Evaluate 3 hedging strategies: (A) sentinel-inject+backoff, (B) prefix-retry with KV-cache rewind, (C) best-effort reconciliation via parser-fallback. Measure success rate and median additional latency.
Instrument decoder to emit debug breadcrumbs for partial emits (token indices, emit-boundaries, sentinel markers) and log to structured telemetry with sampling at 5% for high-volume routes.
Run nightly matrix: models x fixtures x hedging_strategy, collect metrics, generate daily diff report and regression alerts if violation_rate increases >3% absolute.
Include end-to-end canary run on runtime-1.22 with 1% of traffic and automated rollback if recovery_success < 90% after 2k requests.
notes: Tradeoffs: aggressive hedging reduces hard failures but increases latency and token cost; the default policy must be conservative for PLG customers and tunable for Dedicated tenants.
We must avoid any heuristic that changes user-visible output semantics (e.g., silently stripping fields). Instead prefer safe fallbacks that return structured error objects when recovery fails.
Integration with Console: ensure KPIs are labeled by model_version, deployment_tier (hosted/dedicated/private), route, and prompt_tag to enable per-customer slices.
Coordination: inform Support and Solutions about potential increased debug logs during canary to avoid noisy alerts; prepare a short KB article describing what to expect.
This ticket intentionally separates detection/telemetry from automated repair — detection must land first so rollouts are data-driven.
